work.position: Behavior Planning Engineer for Autonomous Systems
highlights: Developed and deployed production-ready decision-making algorithms into the Apollo stack; validated on Kia Soul autonomous vehicle across 50+ scenarios (urban, highway, intersections), achieving 10% performance improvement.
Designed heuristic-based scheduling and planning algorithm for autonomous outdoor cleaning robot; developed and validated in CoppeliaSim with Bullet physics.
Built and maintained bidirectional CARLA–Apollo bridge for sensor data exchange and control integration, enabling simulation-to-deployment workflows.
Designed and optimized trajectory generation algorithms using Frenet-frame representation for smooth, collision-free paths in dynamic environments.
Collaborated with perception and control teams to integrate planning algorithms with sensor pipelines and vehicle actuation systems.

work.company: Center for Cognitive Modeling, Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology
highlights: Developed TAMP framework (FFStreams) combining heuristic search with Streams for real-time adaptive decision-making under safety constraints.
Extended framework with QCNet transformer model for multi-agent trajectory prediction, enabling prediction-aware behavior planning.
Evaluated planning algorithms across multiple benchmark datasets (inD, Argoverse 2, CitySim, INTERACTION, CommonRoad).
Designed learning-based behavior tree algorithms for overtaking and RL-based adaptive parking.
Published in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (Q1) and Springer LNCS.
